review_evidence: README describes seven Lean worlds covering filters, bases, order, principal filters, semilattices, ultrafilters and topology.
14 of 15 Lean files contain proposition declarations, including filter extensionality, basis/filter conversions, principal-filter order laws and neighborhood/topological results.
The filtering contract preserves tutorial/game material when it contains useful formal definitions and proofs; this source has a broad searchable theorem surface.
summary: Reviewed filter-game; retain its pedagogical but substantive formal development of filters and topology.
